verdict.rationale: SumUp's own docs cover pairing Solo readers with a SumUp account through the Cloud API and controlling readers over Bluetooth from an app via the Reader SDKs. They also document starting a transaction from a POS and completing it on the Solo reader, plus testing the pairing and checkout flow with Virtual Solo. Missing for 10: any documented step-by-step pairing walkthrough or evidence that setup to first payment takes only minutes, merchant-facing (non-developer) POS-app pairing flow, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can pair a card reader with the POS app or register it to my account and take a payment within minutes

citations.quote: Pairing multiple Solo card readers with any SumUp account
Use Virtual Solo together with a sandbox merchant account to test the pairing and checkout flow first, then switch to a physical reader later

The Cloud API lets you start a transaction from a Point of Sale (POS) running on any platform (Windows, iOS, Linux, Android, Web-based, etc.) capable of sending HTTPS requests and complete that transaction via a Solo reader.
Your app controls the reader over Bluetooth or uses Tap to Pay.
